title: The Vanished Volcano Model
intro: Just before judging, the prize-winning volcano model has disappeared from its table at the school science fair.

suspects.name: Marcus
suspects.line: My volcano erupted early, so I was cleaning up.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only came to see the baking-soda demo, honest.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: Judges can't be trusted, that's all I'll say.

suspects.name: Yusuf
suspects.line: I was watching the robot team, nothing else.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: I was in the gym looking for my missing glue stick.

clues.text: A baseball cap turned up in the lost property box, a clear sign its owner was over by the fruit punch when the model vanished.
The bike rack shows every bicycle still locked in place, so no bicycle rider could have carried the volcano model away from the fair.
The sign-in sheet shows the ponytail crowd was busy at the sponge-cake stall, so none of them could have been near the volcano table at that time.
A woolly bobble hat was left snagged on the coat hook, its pompom still dripping from a quick dash through the rain.
